problem_app_print_correction.problem: Previous fixed page height plus header exceeded available A4 content height, causing page overflow, overlap, and 20 questions to spill beyond two pages.
problem_app_print_correction.fix: Each A4 page is now a height-limited flex container; title and metadata consume fixed space and the 2-column grid flexes only into the remaining space. Its 5 rows are therefore constrained inside the page.
problem_app_print_correction.expected: 20 questions = exactly two A4 portrait pages; 10 answer boxes per page; no overlap or third page.
